description.value: Donair Dude is a BC-based Mediterranean fast-food chain launched during the 2010 Winter Olympics, serving donair wraps, platters, poutine, and falafel dishes made with locally sourced BC meats. The Nanaimo location on Fifth Street offers a broad menu spanning chicken, beef, lamb, and vegan options, with online ordering available. For a touring cyclist, it is a convenient calorie stop with familiar quick-service format in a central Nanaimo location.
